title: These don’t function as they should.
text: These don’t function as they should.. I loved the color and look of this so much that I ordered an additional one for my kids’ bathroom. After washing and drying for the 1st time, both rugs had dozens of errant threads poking out of both sides. I trimmed them off and I have to do that every time I wash and dry them. That’s literally never happened to me with bath mats or rugs. Also, the way they absorb water feels absolutely murderous on your feet. It’s super clingy wet.  It skeeves me out so bad. And they take forever to dry. Also, they come with a huge tag sewn in them. I trimmed it off but you can see the base of tag. So, they really aren’t reversible.  I would not reorder these again and will be replacing. Too bad because I love the look.

product_metadata.title: Welhome 100% Cotton Reversible Bath Mat Rug | Silver | 20" x 34"| Racetrack Pattern | Absorbent | Super Soft | Comfort | Quick Dry | Durable | Hotel Spa Bathroom Collection | Sustainable
features: COMFORTABLE AND REVERSIBLE - Give your bathroom a refreshing look with the Welhome Cotton Reversible Rug that features a reversible racetrack pattern. The comfortable texture offers a dry and cozy place to stand when you step out of the shower. This bath rug is fully reversible with soft 100% cotton material on both sides offering plush comfort to your feet.

HIGH ABSORBENCY - Being a high 2300 GSM and 100% Cotton means that these bath rugs absorb maximum moisture very quickly off your feet. Choose from 10 neutral shades that easily mix-and match with any current aesthetic.

EXCEPTIONAL QUALITY, SOFT AND DURABLE - These high GSM durable plush cotton rugs are very soft to touch and are bound to provide a luxurious feel. The Unique reversibleness of these rugs will allow you to flip over whenever you wish to and keep up the look of your bathroom.

MADE IN GREEN - These Reversible Rugs are Oeko-Tex Certified and are Made in Green. Oeko-Tex is an independent Certification system that ensures textiles meet high safety and environmental standards. A MADE IN GREEN product ID proves that the product has been tested for harmful substances. It also guarantees that the textile product has been manufactured using sustainable processes under environmentally friendly and socially responsible working conditions.
WASH CARE - Machine wash separately in warm water with gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry at low temperature. Do not Iron. Do not dry clean.
